coverage.basis: the family ships one assembled packet, so rendering it covers every canonical page of the family
coverage.whatCompleteMeansHere: every canonical document is rendered. Boundary and route-level fixtures are declared and bound by hash but are not rendered by this gate, and a defect that appears only in them is not something a RASTER_PASS has excluded.

rasterReceipt.receiptArtifactsNotDownloadedHere: This session cannot fetch workflow artifacts: the download redirects to blob storage the egress proxy denies. The PNG receipts were NOT read here. The binding rests on the pinned commit, the queue's own pinned SHA-256 pair as of that commit (which the batch re-verifies from disk and refuses on mismatch), and the job conclusion.
rasterReceipt.canaryPrecondition: the canary job and its live negative controls passed in the same run (job 101395846747); the family matrix depends on that job, so no family verdict exists without it

supersededReceipts.theBytesOfThatArtifactWereNotInspected: Artifact downloads redirect to blob storage this environment's egress proxy refuses at CONNECT with 403. The artifact id and the zip SHA-256 recorded in the run metadata are durable evidence of WHICH bytes exist and where, not evidence of what they look like.
supersededReceipts.noFixtureHashWasPrintedByTheRunner: The render step printed one verdict line per family and no SHA-256. rcap-raster-batch.mjs re-verifies each fixture from disk and refuses on mismatch, so a green job is evidence the pinned bytes matched at render time; the hashes above were recomputed by Captain from the files on disk at this head and equal both the queue row and the receipt.
